name: theme
title: EDS theme (setmore-black)
description: Earth Design System colours and radius as shadcn theme variables. Install this first; every @eds component and plain shadcn component then looks like EDS.
docs: Values come from the EDS setmore-black brand tokens (background-accent #111111, text-secondary #676767, border-input #dbdbdb, background-critical #c44c44). Font is Inter (EDS body and heading font); EDS apps load it from @adaptavant/eds-fonts, other apps fall back to the system sans-serif.
